name: Web Player Release Candidate
target: reproducible embeddable PICO-8 v0.2.7 web-player release candidate for Chrome/Chromium desktop

releaseProfile.cartAuthority: caller-provided bytes or caller-authorized local bundle
releaseProfile.distributionOutcome: release-ready local artifact; publishing requires a separate explicit user action

architectureBoundaries.runtimeCore: browser-neutral authoritative simulation and session state; no DOM, Canvas, Worker, AudioContext, IndexedDB, File or fetch globals
architectureBoundaries.main: DOM shell, public embed facade, physical input mapping, Canvas presenter and AudioContext lifecycle
architectureBoundaries.worker: only composition root for RuntimeCore, cart codec, z8lua bridge, persistence and local cart repository adapters
architectureBoundaries.worklet: device PCM queue only; no RuntimeCore or VM imports
architectureBoundaries.menuitem: registration and Lua callback references remain VM-local; only copied slot DTOs and generation-bound invocation outcomes cross app transport
architectureBoundaries.assetLoading: stable manifest keys own artifact discovery; filenames are private build output details
architectureBoundaries.saveBoundary: only serialized cartdata crosses the persistence port; renderer and DOM objects are never persisted

embedApiContract.inputAuthority: Uint8Array bytes and bounded local bundle only
requirements: no implicit fetch or global mutable singleton
strict CSP execution with wasm-unsafe-eval as the only evaluation capability
reproducible bytes on the pinned toolchain
no ref, test cart, local corpus or third-party playtest artifacts

compatibilityBaseline.closureRule: required release modes must have evidence-backed compatible status; unsupported modes remain explicit Known Differences and never become compatible by relabeling

7A.name: Activation / Release Contract
exit: Phase 6 baseline files and hashes are frozen
bytes-first local-only release profile and no-publication boundary are machine readable
embed, artifact, UI, menu, conformance and Chrome exit ownership are explicit
docs route exactly one active work unit to 7B
the activation test is part of test and verify
the worktree is clean after a dedicated commit

result.capabilityExpansion: productization plus VM-local menuitem invocation only

7B.name: Stable Embed API
exit: one versioned public root exposes bytes-first create/load/start/pause/resume/reset/stop/dispose and typed events
mutating operations are serialized and dispose is idempotent
load and dispose races cannot commit stale frame, audio, state or diagnostic output
two mounted instances have independent Worker, presenter, input, audio and persistence lifecycle
the public API performs no fetch and accepts no URL authority
Node contract and Chrome production-path tests pass
pnpm run verify passes and 7C becomes the only active work unit

result.inputAuthority: Uint8Array bytes and bounded local bundle only
result.chrome: three independent Worker and AudioContext lifecycles plus load/dispose race

7C.name: Distributable Artifact Pipeline
exit: the release build emits main, Worker, AudioWorklet, WASM, styles and demo behind stable manifest keys
relative-base HTTP deployment, correct MIME and WASM ArrayBuffer fallback boot in Chrome
a verifier checks artifact hashes, byte lengths, CSP policy, provenance and excluded paths
two clean pinned-toolchain builds are byte-identical
no ref, local corpus or third-party playtest artifact is emitted
pnpm run verify passes and 7D becomes the only active work unit

result.wasmLoading: instantiateStreaming for application/wasm; Emscripten ArrayBuffer fallback for wrong MIME
result.csp: self-only with wasm-unsafe-eval and no unsafe-eval

7D.name: Production DOM Player Shell
exit: the default DOM shell supports local choose/drop, play, pause, reset, stop, mute and fullscreen
loading, ready, running, paused, stopped, audio-blocked and faulted states are user-visible and recoverable
keyboard focus, touch controls, aria status, reduced motion and integer-scale resize are covered
UI state does not become authoritative simulation state and the canvas contains only the playfield
Chrome interaction and accessibility tests pass
pnpm run verify passes and 7E becomes the only active work unit

result.viewBoundary: class-driven DOM view and derived-control policy under apps/web-player/src/main/ui
result.localCartInput: one bounded user-selected .p8 or .p8.png file through choose or drop
result.canvas: 128x128 backing store with nearest-neighbor integer CSS scaling
result.accessibility: named landmark/playfield/controls, live status and diagnostics, pressed/disabled semantics, reduced motion and 44 CSS px touch targets
result.chrome: release artifact choose/drop, lifecycle, audio recovery, mute, fullscreen, keyboard, touch, 200 percent narrow viewport, fault recovery and resource disposal

7E.name: Pause Menu / menuitem Completion
exit: a replacement ADR fixes copy-out snapshot, root-safe invoke, callback return, filter, pause and generation semantics before production implementation
the VM exports copied menu slot snapshots without exposing Lua handles or WASM pointers
a paused generation-bound command invokes one registered callback at a Runtime-owned root-safe boundary
replacement, removal, callback fault, reset, cart swap, stale generation and dispose fail closed
the DOM pause menu is keyboard, pointer and touch operable
P6-KD-01 is closed or narrowed by conformance evidence
pnpm run verify passes and 7F becomes the only active work unit

result.snapshotCodec: 104 bytes: 4-byte header plus five 20-byte copy-owned slot records
result.invocation: VM-local callback at a completed root boundary with Left/Right/X filter and instruction budget
result.chrome: P8SCII DOM labels, dialog/focus, keyboard/pointer/touch, 44px targets, filter, keep-open refresh, simulation/audio pause, generation cleanup and fault recovery

7F.name: Required API Conformance Closure
exit: all 28 required unknown APIs have project-owned manual-linked real-WASM conformance vectors
math, bitwise, table iteration, metatable, raw access and select failures are fixed without cart-specific hacks
flip, stat and print are represented by explicit supported modes and published unsupported-mode differences
no required release mode remains unknown and no status is upgraded without behavior evidence
Node and Chrome conformance gates pass
pnpm run verify passes and 7G becomes the only active work unit

result.chrome: same three carts through the production Worker with exact screen hashes and structured fault recovery

7G.name: Chrome Release Hardening
exit: Chrome stable and the fixed Chromium runner cover HTTP MIME, CSP, non-isolated mode and relative base paths
Audio unlock, 44.1/48 kHz, suspend/resume and persistence denied/quota paths recover visibly
visibility, blur, bfcache, fullscreen, resize and multiple-instance teardown are bounded
twenty hang/crash/recover cycles leave one active instance and no stale output
the 600-second 60 Hz desktop soak has zero audio underruns and meets published performance/resource budgets
fuzz, provenance and artifact audit gates pass
pnpm run verify passes and 7H becomes the only active work unit

result.artifactMatrix: correct/wrong WASM MIME, strict CSP, nested relative base and non-isolated boot
result.lifecycle: idempotent blur/visibility, bfcache pagehide/pageshow, fullscreen, integer resize, reduced motion and multi-instance teardown

7H.name: Release Candidate Exit
exit: an aggregate-only exit manifest binds source, WASM, release artifact, Chrome and gate hashes
the compatibility report publishes profile, Known Differences and zero open P0/P1
a minimal local demo and embed documentation reproduce the release artifact without network cart access
pnpm run test:release and pnpm run verify pass from a clean checkout
no registry, website or GitHub release publication occurs
evidence is archived, the phase document is removed and no active phase remains
